search.label: Search your files
search.noneBody: No name or text in your files matches. Try other words.

preview.label: Preview
preview.failed: This file could not be shown.
preview.tooLarge: This file is too large to preview here. Download it to open it.
preview.none: There is no preview for this type of file.
preview.downloadRest: Download the file for the rest.
preview.noText: This file has no text to show.
preview.pdfFallback: If the PDF does not show here, download it.
preview.imageFailed: The image could not be shown.

wellKnown.notSavedPrefilled: Not saved yet. Some values are filled in for you; Save keeps them.
wellKnown.invalid: {{file}} does not match its format, and there is no earlier valid version.
wellKnown.invalidFallback: {{file}} does not match its format. This shows its last valid version.
wellKnown.conflict: {{file}} changed while you were editing it, probably by the assistant or another tab. The newer values are:

check.format: This value has the wrong format.

source.label: Source
source.hint: The raw file. It is checked against the same schema when you save.
source.notObject: The file must be a JSON object, in braces.

persona.title: Assistant
persona.lede: Name and instructions the assistant uses in every chat.

user.title: You
user.lede: The assistant reads this to know who it talks to. It reaches the model in every chat.

ui.title: Appearance
ui.lede: How LocalAI looks for you. Changes show at once; Save keeps them.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.lede: The prompts above the composer of every chat.
shortcuts.none: No shortcuts. Add one, or save an empty list to hide them.
shortcuts.label: Label
shortcuts.assistantPrompt: Change my composer shortcuts in LocalAI/shortcuts.json:

home.title: Title
home.noData: No data yet. The assistant can write
home.noSource: This widget has no data file. Pick one in Edit layout.
home.broken: {{file}} has errors and no earlier valid version.
home.stale: Showing the last valid data: {{file}} has errors.

footer.invalid: {{file}} has an error. Showing the last good version.
footer.fix: Ask the assistant to fix it
footer.fixPrompt: The Home widget reads {{file}}, which is missing or broken. Fix it:
footer.waiting: Waiting for you to create its trigger in the chat.
footer.failedEmpty: The update failed and there is no data yet.
footer.staleToday: Last update failed. Showing earlier data from today.
footer.costRemote: about {{tokens}} tokens a run on a remote model
footer.scheduleNote_one: {{count}} widget updates on a schedule. Its runs use your models and count toward your usage.
footer.scheduleNote_other: {{count}} widgets update on a schedule. Their runs use your models and count toward your usage.

system_prompt.label: System prompt
system_prompt.help: Added to every chat, after the chat's own prompt and the agent's instructions.

language.label: Language
language.help: The language the assistant answers in.

bio.label: About you
bio.help: A few lines the assistant reads in every chat.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.help: For dates and times in answers.

theme.label: Theme
theme.help: System follows the setting of your device.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.help: For buttons and links. Empty keeps the default.

density.label: Density
density.help: Compact shows more on one screen.

defaultModel.label: Default model
defaultModel.help: The model a new chat starts with.

ex.title: Make LocalAI yours
ex.lede: Say it in a chat. The assistant saves it as a file you can change or undo.

card1.prompt: Call me {{firstName}} and keep answers short
card1.promptNoName: Remember my name and keep answers short

card2.what: Adds a page you open from the sidebar

card3.prompt: Every morning, summarise my inbox here
card3.promptNoMail: Every morning, list yesterday's chats here
card3.what: Adds a Home widget and a trigger you confirm

ex.ready: Or start from a ready page:
ex.inComposer: Edit it if you like, then press Enter. Nothing is saved until you send it.
ex.live: Prompt added to the message box.

action.turnBackOn: Turn them back on in Account

change.profilePersona: Saved your name in LocalAI/user.json and your instructions in LocalAI/persona.json. Every chat uses them from your next message.
change.persona: Saved LocalAI/persona.json. Every chat uses it from your next message.
change.offersOff: Suggestions from the assistant are off.

toast.pageCreated: {{title}} is in Pages, in the sidebar

files.learn: These files change how LocalAI works for you.

discovery.privacy: The assistant receives your name, this text, your language and time zone at the start of every chat. Leave a field empty to keep it out.

versions.label: Versions
versions.title: Versions of {{file}}
versions.note: Revert keeps the newer version in this list.
versions.revertGood: Revert to the last good version

help.title: Help and suggestions
help.sub: Ways LocalAI shows you what it can do. Turn off what you do not need.
help.offersHint: At most one a day, never during a task: for example, to remember something you told it.
help.newHint: A short "New" label in the sidebar the first time something appears.
help.examplesShown: The "Make LocalAI yours" cards show on Home while you have something left to try.
help.examplesHidden: You hid the "Make LocalAI yours" cards.
help.examplesBack: The examples are back on Home.
help.dismissedHint_one: You turned down {{count}} offer. It stays hidden until you reset it.
help.dismissedHint_other: You turned down {{count}} offers. They stay hidden until you reset them.
help.forget: Forget what the assistant learned about my hints
help.forgotten: Done. The assistant may offer again.
help.dismissedNone: Nothing yet. When you answer an offer, the assistant remembers it here.

shared.adminLede: Folders that several people use. Members open their pages, and their chats can read or edit the files.
shared.userLede: Folders an administrator shared with you. Their pages are in Pages, and your chats can use the files.
shared.nameHint: Up to 64 letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores. Start with a letter or a digit.
shared.everyoneHint: All users, also the ones who join later
shared.usersUnavailable: The user list could not be loaded. You can still add Everyone.
shared.noMembers: Nobody can use this folder yet. Add a person or Everyone.
shared.paneNote: A change applies at once. A chat that is open sees it the next time it opens.
shared.created: Created “{{name}}”. Add the people who can use it.
shared.removed: Removed “{{name}}”. Its pages ask again before they run.
shared.loadFailed: Could not load the shared folders.
shared.emptyAdminBody: A shared folder holds files and pages that other people can read or edit. Create one, then add members.
shared.factMembers: Give a person or everyone read or edit access
shared.factChats: Members' chats see the folder's files
shared.factUndo: Removing a folder can be undone
shared.emptyUserTitle: Nothing is shared with you yet
shared.emptyUserBody: When an administrator shares a folder with you, it shows here and its pages show in Pages.

about.localai: Settings LocalAI reads: persona, profile, shortcuts, Home, theme.
about.chats: One folder per chat, with the files of the chat.

confirm.restore: You can restore it from the Trash.
confirm.renameNote: LocalAI reads it only under this name, so after a rename it is as if it were gone.

loses.settings: LocalAI forgets your persona, your profile, your shortcuts, your Home layout and your theme.
loses.chats: Every chat loses its files: what you attached and what the assistant wrote there.
loses.persona: The assistant loses its name and its instructions.
loses.user: The assistant forgets what you told it about you, and your answers to its offers.
loses.shortcuts: The message box shows the default shortcuts again.
loses.ui: Your theme, accent, density, default model and pinned pages go back to the defaults.

naming.taken: Something in this folder already has that name.

emptyFolder.title: This folder is empty

emptyFolder.bodyTouch: Upload files from your device. The assistant can also save files here from a chat.

drop.title: Drop to upload to {{folder}}
drop.body: Files and whole folders are welcome.

conflict.body_other: {{folder}} already has files with these names.

move.noFolders: No folders here. Move here, or go back up.
